summary.name: Tor Browser
summary.one_liner: Tor Browser is a privacy-focused web browser from the Tor Project for anonymous browsing and getting around censorship, listed on this download page alongside Tor VPN (beta), Tails, and little-t tor.
use_cases: run a portable privacy-protecting operating system
run Tor on a server or system
summary.what_it_does:
The page is the Tor Project's download hub listing several apps. Tor Browser is described as a browser for surfing the web without compromising privacy or anonymity. Tor VPN (Beta) routes multiple apps through Tor and can be paired with any web browser. Tails is a portable operating system that protects against surveillance and censorship. little-t tor runs Tor directly on a server or system for developers and advanced users who do not need a bundled browser. The page also links to a comparison of the Tor and community apps.</newline_placeholder>
